limitations.text: The original graphic interpretation remains uncertain. The received Shuowen account analyzes 兩 as 一 plus 㒳, while chariot-front and paired-horse explanations remain hypotheses; the evidence does not confirm that the graph joins two 丙 forms.
A modern bronze-script-style redraw was identified, but its image page could not be opened and no direct image URL was verified. No inspectable glyph image is available to select here.
